query: Change my code digest routine to run at 7am instead of 8am.
setup: A managed fleet exists. Injected defects: the deployed digest routine's cron differs from the manifest (someone hand-edited it), and one manifest routine was deleted from the deployment entirely.
expected_behavior: Detects reconcile mode via the deployed 'Fleet watchdog (routine-architect)', locates the ops repo from its first git source, and reads fleet/fleet.json
Runs the FULL diff before applying the requested one-line change, and presents the classification table (DRIFT for the hand-edited cron, GAP for the deleted routine) to the user
Asks the user which direction to converge the DRIFT rather than silently overwriting either side
Applies the 7am change as a manifest edit first (manifest leads, deployment follows), re-runs scripts/validate_fleet.py, then updates the deployment
Redeploys the GAP routine and writes its new trigger_id back
Commits and pushes the manifest, verifies every active entry has a trigger_id, and reports fleet state including what changed this run
